title.en: REGISTERED AGENTS AND TRUSTEES LICENSING AMENDMENT ORDER 2016

source.name: Attorney General's Chambers, Brunei Darussalam (AGC) — LAWS OF BRUNEI / Government Gazette

completenessNote: 来源为 AGC 官方 PDF《S-43-2016-REGISTERED-AGENTS-AND-TRUSTEES-LICENSING-AMENDMENT-ORDER-2016.pdf》（5 页），本次切分 2 条。该 PDF 为扫描件 + OCR 文本层，正文按版式位置重建：已剔除页眉页脚与边栏条标题、回接折行；未改写措辞、未增删内容。OCR 层面可能存在个别粘连或形近字，逐字引用请以原始 PDF 为准。

text.en: Section 35 of the principal Order is amended, in subsection ( I ) , by inserting "28A," immediately before "34," in the first line therefor. Amendment of section 36

Section 36 of the principal Order is amended, in subsection (l)(b/, by inserting "under 28A" immediately after L'Authority" in the third line. Made this 28th. day of Syawal, 1437 Hijriah corresponding to the 2nd. day of August, 2016 at Our Istana Nurul Iman, Bandar Seri Begawan, Brunei Darussalam.

HIS MAJESTY

THE SULTAN AND YANG DI-PERTUAN

BRUNEI DARUSSALAM
